services.name: Back Yard Landscaping
services.description: Your backyard should work as hard as you do. We design and install lush, functional back yard environments — from custom planting beds and lawn restoration to full private retreats.
services.heroText: A great backyard doesn't happen by accident. GOAT Landscaping designs and installs custom back yard landscapes for South Shore homeowners — built to look stunning and hold up year after year.

services.name: Front Yard Landscaping
services.description: Your home's first impression starts at the curb. We design front yard landscapes that turn heads — clean lines, seasonal color, and plants chosen to thrive on the South Shore.
services.heroText: First impressions matter. GOAT Landscaping creates polished, well-structured front yard landscapes that make South Shore homes stand out — and stay standing through every Long Island season.
bullets: Custom planting and garden bed installation

services.name: Paver Installation
services.description: Pavers done right handle Long Island winters without shifting, cracking, or settling. We install premium natural stone and concrete paver systems built to last for decades.
services.heroText: Not all paver installations are built the same. GOAT Landscaping uses proper base preparation, quality materials, and precision installation — so your pavers look great and stay in place for years.
bullets: Polymeric sand finishing and professional sealing

services.name: Driveway Installation
services.description: A statement driveway changes how your home reads from the street. We design and install paver driveways with custom borders and edging that elevate the entire property.
services.heroText: Your driveway makes a statement before anyone reaches your door. GOAT Landscaping installs custom driveways that blend beauty and durability — built for the South Shore's climate and built to impress.

services.name: Patio Installation
services.description: The right patio becomes the most-used space on your property. We build custom outdoor floors designed for entertaining, daily use, and lasting curb appeal — from base prep to final seal.
services.heroText: A well-built patio changes how you live in your home. GOAT Landscaping creates custom patios for South Shore homeowners who want a finished outdoor floor that handles real life and real Long Island weather.
bullets: Custom patio design and layout planning

services.name: Outdoor Living Spaces
services.description: Turn your backyard into a true extension of your home. Pergolas, fire pits, outdoor kitchens, and custom seating areas designed and built by people who care about every detail.
services.heroText: Outdoor living is how the South Shore spends its summers. GOAT Landscaping designs and builds complete outdoor environments — pergolas, fire pits, outdoor kitchens, and custom entertaining spaces built to be used.

faqs.a: We serve Nassau and Suffolk Counties — including Massapequa Park, Seaford, Wantagh, Bellmore, Merrick, Oceanside, Baldwin, Amityville, Lindenhurst, and surrounding communities. Not sure if we cover your area? Call or text us at (516) 217-8909.

faqs.q: How do I get a free estimate?
faqs.a: Call or text us at (516) 217-8909 or submit the form on our website. We typically respond within 1 hour and can schedule a free on-site consultation at your convenience.

faqs.q: What's your process from start to finish?
faqs.a: We start with a free on-site consultation, then provide a detailed written quote before any work begins. Once approved, our crew handles everything — materials, installation, and cleanup — with no surprises.

faqs.q: When's the best time to start a project?
faqs.a: Spring and fall are the most popular seasons, but we work year-round. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks out to secure your spot on the schedule.

faqs.q: What's the difference between a landscaping company and a lawn care service?
faqs.a: A lawn care service handles recurring maintenance — mowing, fertilizing, edging. A landscaping company designs and builds your outdoor space from the ground up — grading, planting, hardscaping, patios, driveways, and full outdoor environments.
